svg.title: Image-description evidence ladder
svg.desc: The November 9 handler object and November 10 API-class mocked fetch are observed source-level edges. Composer entry, actual HTTP, server/provider acceptance and final image description are not observed.

g.text: Two source-level edges; no network receipt
9 Nov · tagged handler object at mocked API method
Aligned, shifted, comma-bearing, missing and empty cases captured
10 Nov · tagged API class at mocked fetch
JSON body preserved each saved object, including wrong-image alt
Released CLI, actual HTTP and Postiz server
